scripts.prepublish: bun run web:build && bun run server:build && bun run web:typegen && bun run server:typegen
scripts.web:build: bun build web/logger.ts --outdir ./dist/web && bun build web/debugger.ts --packages external --outdir ./dist/web
scripts.web:typegen: bunx dts-bundle-generator --out-file ./dist/web/index.d.ts --export-referenced-types true --inline-declare-global true --inline-declare-externals true -- web/index.t.ts
scripts.server:typegen: bunx dts-bundle-generator --out-file ./dist/server/index.d.ts --export-referenced-types true --inline-declare-global true --inline-declare-externals true -- server/logger.ts
